INSERT INTO wx_mass_target_log ( id,task_id, invoke_id, chat_type, target_id, user_id, status, send_time, tenant_id,create_time,update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id},#{item.taskId}, #{item.invokeId}, #{item.chatType}, #{item.targetId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.status}, #{item.sendTime}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.createTime},#{item.updateTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), send_time = VALUES(send_time), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT invoke_id AS invokeId, COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deliveredCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unsentCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failFriendCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failOtherCnt FROM wx_mass_target_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY invoke_id ORDER BY invoke_id DESC

SELECT invoke_id AS invokeId, user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deliveredCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unsentCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failFriendCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failOtherCnt FROM wx_mass_target_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY invoke_id, user_id
